name: Mac and Cheese Croquettes
description: Indulge in the ultimate comfort food with our Gastro Mac 'n' British Cheese Croquettes, a blend of three melty cheeses and tender, perfectly cooked pasta envelopes. Each bite features a crispy parsley breadcrumb coating, complemented by a sweet honey and zesty chilli dip.

name: 10 Spanish Serrano Ham and Manchego Rollitos
Cheesy Chilli Beef Nachos
description: Our nachos are a fiesta of flavours, featuring crispy tortilla chips layered with minced beef in a tomato and chilli sauce. All this is topped off with Cheddar cheese, soured cream and jalapeño peppers. Our beef is 100% British and traceable back to the farm and animal it came from.

name: Collection Sticky Fig and Hot Honey Chutney
Dinky and Mighty Shareable Popcorn Chicken
Duck Spring Rolls
description: Enjoy a tempting takeaway at home with our Duck Spring Rolls. Crispy pastry is wrapped around aromatic duck and crunchy vegetables in a rich hoisin sauce. Pop them on a plate as a starter or main meal accompaniment.

name: Hash Brown Fries
description: Our Hash Brown Fries feature shredded potato, lightly seasoned and fried to achieve that golden, crispy finish. Serve with bacon, eggs and sausages for a bold twist on a full English breakfast.

name: Mac and Cheese Bites
description: Coated in a crispy golden crumb, our Mac and Cheese Bites pack a punch of flavour with every bite. Made to share with family and friends.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
description: Our Mozzarella Sticks will please the crowd at family gatherings. They're coated in crisp, golden breadcrumbs for a crunchy outside that contrasts with the gooey, melted cheese inside.

name: Salt and Pepper Chicken
description: Our oven-ready Salt and Pepper Chicken saves you prep time on busy evenings. The succulent chicken breasts, sourced from our trusted M&S Select Farms, are marinated in five spices and chilli. Each piece is coated in deliciously seasoned batter for a crisp bite.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
description: Our Vegetable Spring Rolls are filled with beansprouts, edamame soybeans, carrots, water chestnuts, and rice noodles, all wrapped in layers of crispy pastry.

name: Collection Vietnamese Black Tiger Prawns and Marie Rose Dip
Slow Cooked Shred N' Share Bao Buns
Calabrian Suino Nero Pancetta with Black Pepper
Collection Italian Puttanesca With Leccino Olives and Wild Capers
Collection Labneh Yogurt Dip with Herb Dressing
Collection Scottish Tataki Style Seared Salmon with a Ponzu Dip
Chunky Chips
description: Our vegan-friendly Chunky Chips are coated in a lightly seasoned batter for a satisfying crunch. These ready-to-cook potato chips make a hearty side for Fish Friday or a comforting snack. Produced in the UK with potatoes from trusted M&S Select Farms.

name: Garlic Baguette Twin Pack
description: Dip our Garlic Baguette into your favourite pasta dishes or soups for a comforting combo. The baguette bread is generously slathered with a rich garlic butter infused with roasted garlic, fresh parsley and thyme. Simply bake in the oven for warm, crusty bread.

name: Our Best Ever Beef Lasagne
description: Our Best Ever Beef Lasagne is developed by our in-house chefs, featuring 100% British beef, slow-cooked in a rich Chianti red wine and pork pancetta ragu. Layered between sheets of delicate egg pasta and creamy Grana Padano béchamel sauce, it's topped with mature Cheddar for a golden, bubbling finish.

name: Peppercorn Sauce
description: Made with rich beef stock, aromatic green peppercorns, Dijon mustard, thyme and a dash of brandy, our creamy Peppercorn Sauce will turn a family dinner into a restaurant-quality experience at home.

name: Beef Bolognese Sauce
description: Made with succulent mince from UK farms we know and trust, our Beef Bolognese Sauce is extra rich and comforting. True to the classic recipe, it features juicy tomatoes and a hint of wine to boost its complex flavours.

name: British Chicken Forestiere
description: Indulge in the sumptuous creaminess of our Gastropub Chicken Forestiere, featuring tender, British chicken breasts in a luxurious white wine, mushroom and shallot sauce. Finished with chestnut mushrooms, red onions, roasted bacon lardons and a sprinkle of parsley.

name: British Chicken Parmigiana
description: Our Gastropub Chicken Parmigiana features two succulent British chicken breasts, breaded and fried, then smothered in a rich tomato and basil sauce. These are then topped with a beautifully gooey blend of mozzarella and mature West Country farmhouse cheddar.

name: Chicken Pasta Bake
description: Our Chicken Pasta Bake is a hearty meal for a cosy night in. It combines tender marinated chicken breast with a rich tomato sauce and creamy mozzarella, mixed with perfectly al dente Italian pasta.

name: Chip Shop Curry Sauce
description: Get the comforting taste of a British takeaway in your kitchen with our Chip Shop Curry Sauce. Crafted with a mix of chicken stock, soy sauce, and a blend of spices, this rich sauce is one of the nation's favourites and pairs beautifully with battered fish.

name: Chip Shop Mushy Peas
description: Serve up our Chip Shop Mushy Peas for a true taste of a British chippy at your table. They're lightly seasoned with salt and white pepper, and made with no artificial additives.

name: Classic Chicken and Gravy Shortcrust Pie
description: Choose our Classic Chicken & Gravy Shortcrust Pastry Pie for a convenient and comforting taste of home cooking. Encased in a butter-enriched shortcrust pastry and filled with tender British chicken in a rich roast chicken gravy, it goes perfectly with chips and tenderstem broccoli.

name: Collection Calabrian Pepperoni and 'Nduja Pizza
description: Our wood-fired Collection Calabrian Pepperoni and 'Nduja Pizza is crafted with hand-stretched dough made from specialty-grade flours, for a beautifully charred crust. It's generously topped with thickly sliced Calabrian pepperoni, rich and spicy Calabrian 'Nduja and creamy Italian mozzarella pearls. Drizzle with the chilli-infused hot honey just before serving for a sweet, fiery finish. Our pizzas are made with a blend of the best Italian 00 flour and strong white pizza flour. The dough is slow-fermented for 30 hours using a traditional process the Italians call 'Biga', for a complex flavour.

name: Creamed Spinach
description: Enough for two, our Creamed Spinach combines tender spinach leaves with cream, butter, shallots and a hint of cheese.

name: Crispy Potato Wedges
description: Crunchy on the outside and fluffy in the middle, these seasoned Crispy Potato Wedges are a family favourite side dish.

name: Crispy Sweet and Sour Chicken
description: Battered mini chicken fillets are served with a sweet and sour sauce made with juicy pineapple and crisp red pepper.

name: Fresh Tagliatelle
description: Our Fresh Tagliatelle is made with free-range eggs for a silky texture. This vegetarian-friendly choice is made by one of Italy’s oldest pasta producers and features our Eat Well flower so you know each fork-twirling bite is a healthy choice.

name: Mini Spare Ribs
description: Only 100% British pork is chosen for our Mini Spare Ribs. They've been slow-cooked and covered in a sweet soy and Shaoxing rice wine sauce, inspired by traditional Chinese flavours. Enjoy them as a tantalising starter or a main dish with a side of special fried rice.

name: Our Best Ever Macaroni Cheese
description: Our Best Ever Macaroni Cheese has comfort in every bite with its creamy three-cheese sauce and tender free-range egg pasta. Topped with oozy mozzarella, a sprinkle of fresh parsley and a crispy onion and garlic ciabatta crumb, this dish elevates a classic with a delightful crunch.

name: Parmentier Potatoes
description: For an elegant upgrade on your usual potato side, try our crispy, herby Parmentier Potatoes. Cubes of British potatoes are ready to bake in a shallot and garlic butter infused with aromatic thyme.

name: Potato Dauphinoise
description: Elevate a midweek dinner of pan-fried chicken breast and steamed veg with our Potato Gratin Dauphinois. It's a luxurious blend of sliced potatoes in a creamy garlic sauce, topped with Emmental and mature cheddar cheese.

name: Sweet Potato Fries
description: For battered fries without the fiddle, these sweet potato pieces are ready-coated in a lightly seasoned batter for a crisp finish. Just pop them in the oven and they're ready in just 17 minutes.

name: Italian Ricotta, Porcini and Truffle Mezzelune
description: Our ravioloni deliver a taste of Italy with every bite. These egg pasta parcels are generously filled with creamy buffalo milk ricotta, earthy porcini mushrooms and aromatic truffle.

name: Collection British Aberdeen Angus Gold Ribeye Steak
Collection British Aberdeen Angus Gold Rump Steak
Collection British Wagyu Gold Ribeye Steak
Collection Golden Sweet Chilli Prawn Bao Buns
description: Our Collection Golden Sweet Chilli Prawn Bao Buns are handmade in small batches, ensuring exceptional quality and taste. They are filled with responsibly sourced black tiger prawns, spring onions, and sweet red chillies, then sprinkled with black and white sesame seeds for a satisying crunch.

name: Collection Sausage Ragu with Calabrian Nduja Mafalde
description: Our Sausage Ragu with Calabrian 'Nduja Mafalde combines rich Calabrian 'nduja sauce with British outdoor-bred pork sausage, Italian mascarpone and fresh basil. It's served with slow-dried, bronze-cut mafalde (a ribbon-shaped pasta), which has the perfect craggly texture to cling to the moreish sauce.

name: Spicy 'Nduja, Pork and Fennel Ravioli
description: These soft and pillowy egg pasta parcels are generously filled with a blend of rich flavours. Spicy 'Nduja is complemented by aromatic fennel and succulent pork. Simply serve with a drizzle of olive oil for an easy Italian-inspired meal in minutes.

name: 12 Garlic Butter Doughballs
description: Serving up Italian? Make a meal of it with our ready-to-bake Garlic Butter Doughballs. Each fluffy centre is filled with an oozing garlic and parsley butter, full of the flavour of the Mediterranean.

name: Sesame Prawn Toasts
description: Create your own Chinese takeaway with our Sesame Prawn Toasts. These crispy, fried toast triangles are generously topped with succulent prawns, crunchy sesame seeds and fresh spring onions, making them a perfect starter or snack. Our fish is always responsibly sourced and traceable for the highest quality.

name: Cauliflower Cheese
description: When you're all dining together, serve up this family-size Cauliflower Cheese. Tender cauliflower florets are smothered in a creamy cheese sauce, topped with a generous sprinkle of mature cheddar cheese.

name: Dough Sticks with Garlic Butter Dip
description: Our stonebaked ciabatta sticks come complete with a creamy garlic butter dip for the ultimate starter. Bake and serve within a few minutes.

name: Tenderstem Broccoli, Petit Pois and Cavolo Nero
description: Spruce up your five-a-day mission with Tenderstem Broccoli, Petit Pois & Cavolo Nero. This vibrant mix of crisp broccoli, sweet petit pois, and rich cavolo nero is complemented with a hint of salted cracked black pepper butter to add a fresh, gourmet touch to your nutritious dinner.

name: Collection Wagyu Beef Dripping Yorkshire Pudding
description: Crafted in Yorkshire, these light, golden Yorkshire puddings from our Collection range use rich British Wagyu beef dripping for an extra depth of flavour. A true taste of the best of traditional cooking.

name: Gastropub Fiery Mac and Cheese by Tom
description: Our Fiery Mac and Cheese by Tom combines cooked pasta with a rich cheese and red chilli sauce. It’s topped with crunchy red chilli breadcrumbs, stretchy mozzarella, nutty Regato and a sprinkle of parsley. Run, don't walk, to try this epic addition to Tom Kerridge's exclusive Gastropub range.

name: Collection Cauliflower Cheese
description: Tender cauliflower florets in a creamy cheese sauce made with Cornish Cruncher cheddar, emmental and mozzarella, are finished with a golden, crunchy topping of savoury breadcrumbs with cheddar cheese and a sprinkling of parsley.

name: Collection Handcrafted Garlic Baguette
description: Created by master bakers, our Collection Handcrafted Garlic Baguette is made using a slowly fermented dough before it's baked in a stonebed oven. It's abundantly hand-filled and topped with parsley, shallot and roasted garlic butter.

name: Crispy Halloumi Fries
description: The partnership of golden breadcrumbs and squeaky cheese comes together in our Crispy Halloumi Fries. Each pack contains a sachet of sweet chilli dip, adding a delightful kick to these irresistible snacks.

name: Dauphinoise Potatoes
description: M&S potato slices layered with a creamy garlic sauce, topped with Emmental cheese, resulting in a sumptuous melt-in-the-mouth experience. This dish is part of our Gastropub range where M&S quality meets new modern twists and gastronomic techniques. Developed in our kitchens, with ingredients you'll find in our Foodhalls and store cupboards at home.

name: Gastropub Buttery Potato and Onion Bake by Tom
description: Enjoy a quick and flavourful midweek meal with our Gastropub Buttery Potato and Onion Bake by Tom. It features layers of tender, sliced potatoes covered with caramelised onions and savoury brown butter. The grated West Country mature cheddar topping ensures a rich, tangy finish.

name: Prepared and Ready to Roast Butternut Squash, Carrots & Parsnips
description: Simplify your cooking with our Prepared and Ready to Roast Butternut Squash, Carrots & Parsnips. It contains a mix of carrots, butternut squash and parsnips, all coated in rapeseed oil and honey with a knob of butter, plus a sprig of rosemary to garnish.

name: Collection Goose Fat Roast Potatoes
description: Turn weeknight dinners into special occasions with these potatoes, basted in goose fat for a crisp, golden bite every time. Serve alongside roasted meats, fresh vegetables and onion gravy.

name: Broccoli, Greens, Leeks and Petit Pois
description: Our Prepared and Ready to Cook Broccoli, Greens, Leeks and Petit Pois combines vibrant broccoli, sweet petit pois, crunchy spring greens and tender leeks with roasted garlic and shallot butter.

name: Salt and Pepper Sweet Potato Wedges
description: These sweet potato wedges are conveniently prepared and ready to cook. Generously seasoned with salt, black pepper and a paprika oil dressing, they have a smoky flavour and a satisfyingly crisp finish.

name: 2 Garlic Baguettes
description: These aromatic baguettes are filled with rich garlic butter and baked with a golden, crispy crust. Enjoy alongside pasta dishes or dip into soups.

name: 4 Garlic and Parsley Ciabatta Sticks
description: These ciabatta sticks are a must-have for any Italian-inspired meal. Infused with extra virgin olive oil, aromatic garlic and fresh parsley, they turn gorgeously golden and crunchy when baked.

name: 4 Stonebaked Garlic Flatbreads
description: Add an authentic pizzeria side to your table with our moreish Garlic Flatbreads. Stone baking creates a crusty exterior with a soft, fluffy middle, while the garlic and parsley butter topping simply melts in the mouth. Share as a starter or as an accompaniment to pasta night dinner.

name: 4 Yorkshire Puddings
description: Our Yorkshire Puddings are a classic addition to your Sunday roast. Expertly crafted to rise high and golden, each pudding has a crisp exterior with a fluffy, airy centre. Made with top-quality ingredients, these little puddings will add a sense of tradition and warmth to your dining table.

name: 6 Cheese Croquettes
description: Our Cheese Croquettes blend creamy British potato with extra mature cheddar, wrapped in a golden, crisp crumb. A splendid companion to your evening meal or a hearty party snack.

name: 6 Cheesy Garlic Butter Bread Slices
description: Ready to serve warm in minutes, our cheesy garlic slices will add a crunchy bite to an Italian dish. Six baguette slices are topped with an aromatic garlic and parsley butter with cheese.

name: Battered Potato Slices
description: Thin slices of potato coated in a perfectly seasoned batter. Oven cook to give them a golden colour and satisfying crunch.

name: Beef Dripping Yorkshire Puddings
description: Elevate your roast dinner with our Beef Dripping Yorkshire Puddings. Expertly made in Yorkshire, they boast a golden, crispy exterior with a fluffy centre that begs to be filled with gravy.

name: Broccoli Cheese Bake
description: Make the side dish the star of the show with our Broccoli Cheese Bake, made with tender broccoli florets, a creamy cheese sauce and a generous topping of mature cheddar cheese.

name: Buttery Mashed Potato
description: Made with cream and butter, this ready-made mashed potato is rich, quick and comforting. It has a fluffy, silky-smooth consistency and is lightly seasoned with sea salt and cracked black pepper. Pair with roast chicken, fish cakes or a simple veggie side.

name: Cheddar Cheese Mashed Potato
description: Save on prep time with our cheesy mashed potato. It's made with mature cheddar cheese – plus a touch of butter, sea salt and cracked black pepper – for a smooth, creamy consistency. A versatile side dish, it will pair well with your go-to meat and fish dishes.

name: Cheese and Bacon Croquettes
description: Our Cheese & Bacon Croquettes are made with bacon sourced from trusted M&S Select Farms. They combine creamy mashed potato with smoked bacon and mature Cheddar cheese, encased in a golden breadcrumb coating for a crispy finish.

name: Cowboy Corn Long Ribs with Chipotle Butter
description: Prepared and ready to cook, these sweet corn long ribs are coated in rich butter with smoky chipotle chilli and herbs for a bold, barbecue-style flavour. Cut for maximum caramelisation, they deliver a juicy bite and subtle heat, perfect for grilling, roasting or oven cooking.

name: Creamy Mushrooms
description: Enhance a steak dish with these mushrooms. The pack features a blend of chestnut and button mushrooms in a velvety cream sauce.

name: Crispy Potato Waffle Fries
description: Our Crispy Potato Waffle Fries are expertly crafted from skin-on potatoes, lightly fried in a seasoned batter for that ultimate crunch. Sourced from trusted growers, these lattice fries feature a delightful texture and full-flavoured taste, making them a great choice for a satisfying side.

name: Crispy and Fluffy Triple Cooked Chips
Gastropub Hot Maple Roasted Veg
description: Our tender and sweet Gastropub Hot Maple Roasted Veg make an elevated vegetable side. Buttery carrots, butternut squash and red onion, in a sticky Canadian maple syrup and chilli glaze, are topped with a sprig of thyme.

name: It's Cauliflower Cheese and Marmite
description: If you love the taste of yeast extract, you'll love our It's Cauliflower Cheese and Marmite. The veggie florets are covered in a sumptuous extra mature cheddar cheese sauce and crowned with a crispy, savoury breadcrumb topping.

name: Made Without Wheat Yorkshire Puddings
description: These Yorkshire puddings are the gluten-free version of the Sunday roast favourite. They're fluffy, risen and golden with a perfectly crisp texture that's a sublime accompaniment to roast beef.

name: Peas and Carrots with Mint Butter
description: Pick up a pack of our garden-fresh peas and crunchy carrots, gently tossed in seasoned mint butter for a hint of zing. Ready in minutes, add a portion to weeknight dinners for a splash of colour on the plate.

name: Potatoes, Carrots, Cabbage and Broccoli with Mint Butter
description: This vegetable selection comprises potatoes, carrots, cabbage and broccoli in a mint butter. This medley is an easy-to-prepare side dish, microwaveable in just 3 minutes.

name: Yorkshire Puddings
description: Our Yorkshire Puddings are made in Yorkshire for the traditional taste you know and love. They're light and crispy, making them the perfect accompaniment for your next roast dinner.
